SYMPTOM: All 20 Maestro flows started failing on `assertVisible: id: HomeView` after adding `.accessibilityIdentifier` to tab bar items in MainTabView
CAUSE: SwiftUI's accessibility tree generation changes when tab items have explicit identifiers — breaks how child view identifiers like `HomeView` are resolved in the accessibility hierarchy
FIX: Reverted tab item identifiers. Handle tab tap conflicts with point coordinates instead (Scenarios tab: `point: "63%,95%"`)
PREVENT: Never add .accessibilityIdentifier to SwiftUI tab items. Use point-based taps for ambiguous text in tab bars.
